roles.name: Prophet
roles.description: Speaks God's word with authority and warning.

roles.name: King / Queen
roles.description: Rules, judges, and bears the weight of a people's fate.

roles.name: Priest
roles.description: Offers prayer, sacrifice, and mediation between God and people.

roles.name: Shepherd
roles.description: Leads, protects, and knows each one by name.

roles.name: Wanderer
roles.description: Exiled, traveling, and carrying hope across unfamiliar lands.

roles.name: Witness
roles.description: Sees and testifies; refuses to stay silent.

roles.name: Saint / Believer
roles.description: Ordinary faith that endures suffering and waits for resurrection.

roles.name: Outcast
roles.description: Rejected by the world, welcomed by God.

roles.name: Teacher
roles.description: Explains the law, parable, and the deeper meaning.

roles.name: Judge
roles.description: Weighs causes, pronounces verdicts, and laments what justice costs.

roles.name: Messenger / Angel
roles.description: Delivers word, warning, and impossible promise.
